question: Eight friends, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W, are sitting clockwise in the same order around a circular table at equal distances between them, facing the center of the table. If S is sitting in the west, then who is sitting in the south-west direction?
solution:
**Eight friends: **P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W.

1) Clockwise in the same order around a circular table at equal distances between them, facing the center of the table. If S is sitting in the west, then who is sitting in the south-west direction. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd8c9176670bb2523ca40eeda9a6ba672aa310c650f47b790b66310866658a18.png] 

Clearly, R is sitting in South-west direction.

Hence, the correct answer is **"R".**
